hebrewText: וְ/לָקַחְתִּ֞י אֶת שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֨מוּ פְנֵי/הֶ֜ם לָ/ב֣וֹא אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַיִם֮ לָ/ג֣וּר שָׁם֒ וְ/תַ֨מּוּ כֹ֜ל בְּ/אֶ֧רֶץ מִצְרַ֣יִם יִפֹּ֗לוּ בַּ/חֶ֤רֶב בָּֽ/רָעָב֙ יִתַּ֔מּוּ מִ/קָּטֹן֙ וְ/עַד גָּד֔וֹל בַּ/חֶ֥רֶב וּ/בָ/רָעָ֖ב יָמֻ֑תוּ וְ/הָיוּ֙ לְ/אָלָ֣ה לְ/שַׁמָּ֔ה וְ/לִ/קְלָלָ֖ה וּ/לְ/חֶרְפָּֽה

tokens.bdb: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: a remainder or residual (surviving, final) portion
tokens.kjv: that had escaped, be left, posterity, remain(-der), remnant, residue, rest.

tokens.bdb: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
tokens.kjv: Judah.
tokens.explanation: Yehudah — Judá, quarto filho de Jacó, tribo e reino

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.bdb: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, [phrase] disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, [phrase] name, [idiom] on, ordain, order, [phrase] paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), [phrase] regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, [phrase] stedfastly, take, [idiom] tell, [phrase] tread down, (over-)turn, [idiom] wholly, work.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanation: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanationEn: to put (used in a great variety of applications

tokens.bdb: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] accept, a-(be-) fore(-time), against, anger, [idiom] as (long as), at, [phrase] battle, [phrase] because (of), [phrase] beseech, countenance, edge, [phrase] employ, endure, [phrase] enquire, face, favour, fear of, for, forefront(-part), form(-er time, -ward), from, front, heaviness, [idiom] him(-self), [phrase] honourable, [phrase] impudent, [phrase] in, it, look(-eth) (-s), [idiom] me, [phrase] meet, [idiom] more than, mouth, of, off, (of) old (time), [idiom] on, open, [phrase] out of, over against, the partial, person, [phrase] please, presence, propect, was purposed, by reason of, [phrase] regard, right forth, [phrase] serve, [idiom] shewbread, sight, state, straight, [phrase] street, [idiom] thee, [idiom] them(-selves), through ([phrase] -out), till, time(-s) past, (un-) to(-ward), [phrase] upon, upside ([phrase] down), with(-in, [phrase] -stand), [idiom] ye, [idiom] you.
tokens.enLiteralWord: the face ; used in a great variety of applications ; also  as a preposition (before
tokens.explanation: panim — face, presença, frente (sempre plural em hebraico)
tokens.explanationEn: the face ; used in a great variety of applications ; also  as a preposition (before

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.
tokens.explanation: bo — vir, ir, entrar, chegar, avançar em direção a algo

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra

tokens.bdb: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
tokens.kjv: Egypt, Egyptians, Mizraim.
tokens.explanation: Mitsrayim — Egito. A terra das "duas margens" do Nilo

tokens.bdb: properly, to turn aside from the road (for a lodging or any other purpose), i.e. sojourn (as a guest); also to shrink, fear (as in a strange place); also to gather forhostility (as afraid)
tokens.kjv: abide, assemble, be afraid, dwell, fear, gather (together), inhabitant, remain, sojourn, stand in awe, (be) stranger, [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
tokens.kjv: in it, [phrase] thence, there (-in, [phrase] of, [phrase] out), [phrase] thither, [phrase] whither.

tokens.bdb: to complete, in a good or a bad sense, literal, or figurative, transitive or intransitive
tokens.kjv: accomplish, cease, be clean (pass-) ed, consume, have done, (come to an, have an, make an) end, fail, come to the full, be all gone, [idiom] be all here, be (make) perfect, be spent, sum, be (shew self) upright, be wasted, whole.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra

tokens.bdb: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
tokens.kjv: Egypt, Egyptians, Mizraim.
tokens.explanation: Mitsrayim — Egito. A terra das "duas margens" do Nilo

tokens.bdb: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
tokens.kjv: be accepted, cast (down, self, (lots), out), cease, die, divide (by lot), (let) fail, (cause to, let, make, ready to) fall (away, down, -en, -ing), fell(-ing), fugitive, have (inheritance), inferior, be judged (by mistake for H6419 (פָּלַל)), lay (along), (cause to) lie down, light (down), be ([idiom] hast) lost, lying, overthrow, overwhelm, perish, present(-ed, -ing), (make to) rot, slay, smite out, [idiom] surely, throw down.

tokens.bdb: drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement
tokens.kjv: axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool.

tokens.bdb: hunger (more or less extensive)
tokens.kjv: dearth, famine, [phrase] famished, hunger.

tokens.bdb: to complete, in a good or a bad sense, literal, or figurative, transitive or intransitive
tokens.kjv: accomplish, cease, be clean (pass-) ed, consume, have done, (come to an, have an, make an) end, fail, come to the full, be all gone, [idiom] be all here, be (make) perfect, be spent, sum, be (shew self) upright, be wasted, whole.

tokens.bdb: abbreviated, i.e. diminutive, literally (in quantity, size or number) or figuratively (in age or importance)
tokens.kjv: least, less(-er), little (one), small(-est, one, quantity, thing), young(-er, -est).

tokens.bdb: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
tokens.kjv: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, [phrase] how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ([phrase] as) yet.

tokens.bdb: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
tokens.kjv: [phrase] aloud, elder(-est), [phrase] exceeding(-ly), [phrase] far, (man of) great (man, matter, thing,-er,-ness), high, long, loud, mighty, more, much, noble, proud thing, [idiom] sore, ([idiom]) very.

tokens.bdb: drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement
tokens.kjv: axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool.

tokens.bdb: hunger (more or less extensive)
tokens.kjv: dearth, famine, [phrase] famished, hunger.

tokens.bdb: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill
tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, [idiom] crying, (be) dead (body, man, one), (put to, worthy of) death, destroy(-er), (cause to, be like to, must) die, kill, necro(-mancer), [idiom] must needs, slay, [idiom] surely, [idiom] very suddenly, [idiom] in (no) wise.

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: an imprecation
tokens.kjv: curse, cursing, execration, oath, swearing.

tokens.bdb: ruin; by implication, consternation
tokens.kjv: astonishment, desolate(-ion), waste, wonderful thing.

tokens.bdb: vilification
tokens.kjv: (ac-) curse(-d, -ing).

tokens.bdb: contumely, disgrace, the pudenda
tokens.kjv: rebuke, reproach(-fully), shame.
